none: PAS CAM-616D28: Roman Coin: Nummus probably of Valens
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [GLORIA ROMANORVM] ; D/ D N VALEN[...]

A copper-alloy nummus probably of Valens, AD364-378. AD364-378, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Reverse shows Emperor advancing right dragging captive and holding standard. Mint unknown. Obverse shows Diademed bust right. Obverse legend reads D N VALEN[...]. Condition is fine, die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 2.28g, diameter is 17.8mm
